## The three tenets

Every resource must satisfy all three:

- [ ] **Strictly free** — no paywalls, no trials, no hidden costs
- [ ] **Location-agnostic** — globally accessible, no regional restrictions
- [ ] **High utility** — actionable educational material, not filler

## Suggested classification

- **Section:** Learn / Build / AI / Research / Discover / Communities
- **Stack:** Web Development / Computer Science / AI & ML / etc.
- **Type:** Course / Documentation / Book / Interactive / etc.
- **Difficulty:** Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced

## Why does this belong?

A sentence or two on why this resource is worth including.
